## Local checks and evidence

<!-- Record exact commands and actual results, including failures/limits.

Do not claim Docker, browser, or output-comparison checks you did not run. -->

## CI evidence

<!-- Link the Backend tests run for the latest commit and record its outcome/SHA.

## Teammate review

<!-- Request a teammate reviewer. Point them to behavior, tests, or clarity that
needs attention. Reviewers: leave specific comments and submit a review with an
explanation; approval alone is insufficient. Authors: reply and address concerns.
Keep review permalinks for individual participation evidence. -->

- [ ] Latest required Backend tests check passes.
- [ ] A teammate reviewed meaningfully and approved the current change.
- [ ] Review concerns are addressed and conversations resolved.

See [collaboration guidance](../docs/collaboration.md) and
[group setup](../docs/template.md). Merge reviewed feature branches into `main`.
